title: Kissed Springy Slovakian Milk Bake
description: A traditional Slovakian dessert featuring whole milk and a jammy texture, baked to perfection in a wood-fired kadhai. This dairy-free-friendly version is perfect for those with dietary restrictions.

ingredients.name: wood-fired baked crust
ingredients.notes: or substitute with regular pastry crust

instructions: Preheat the wood-fired kadhai to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Whisk together the milk, sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract in a large bowl.
Add the flour and baking powder to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Pour the mixture into the preheated kadhai.
Drop spoonfuls of jam onto the surface of the mixture.
Use a spatula to create a swirly design on the surface.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.
Remove from the kadhai and let cool for 10 minutes.
